# Scarp Studio v0.0.2-alpha.1 — Windows compiler-integrated IDE (DRAFT)

> **Unpublished release-note candidate.** No tag or GitHub release is authorized by this file. The source remains under stacked PR review until CI, manual Windows acceptance and explicit owner approval are complete.

**Experimental, unsigned Windows x64 pre-release candidate** for the Scarp programming language only (`.srp`). It is not a stable IDE. Keep backups of important work and use disposable sources when evaluating the candidate.

## What is planned to be included

- Tauri 2 + React/TypeScript + Monaco Scarp-only editor, syntax highlighting, hover, completion snippets, function outline, starter programs, theme and editor settings.
- Multiple tabs and source snapshots with dirty indicators; carefully guarded Open, Save, Save As, Save All and Reload from Disk.
- Bounded Scarp project Explorer for the selected root and the immediate `src/`, `tests/` and `examples/` directories. Refresh is manual; source reads are limited and scoped to the user-selected folder.
- Quick Open, Go to Line, open-buffer search, Unicode-safe literal Replace All with preview/confirmation and one-level guarded Undo. These operate on open editor buffers, not arbitrary files across disk.
- Explicitly selected and trusted **separately installed official Scarp compiler** for Run and static Verify. A real compiler executes saved sources only on user action; there is no fake Run, bundled compiler, PATH search, silent installation or automatic execution.
- Stop during a compiler version/capability probe or a running compiler process. Bounded stdin/prompt input and process-output capture.
- Project Info, Verify Project, Run Project, List Tests and Run Tests when the selected compiler supports the audited CLI. Structured test output is parsed strictly; stale test summaries are invalidated after selected-project source or Explorer changes.
- Structured diagnostics on failed static Verify, with snapshot-safe Monaco navigation and UTF-16/Unicode column conversion. When a source or selected project changes during an in-flight compiler command, the completed output is clearly marked as coming from an older snapshot; stale structured errors/test results cannot be applied to the current editor.
- Native source/file read safeguards, concurrent-operation guards, and exact-run Windows artifact SHA-256 validation with tamper and extra-file rejection.

## Official compiler compatibility

This candidate **does not include or auto-download any compiler**. Windows CI checks separately downloaded, SHA-256-pinned official Scarp CLI archives for `v0.0.6-alpha.10` through `v0.0.6-alpha.15`.

The alpha.15 smoke gate validates the published Windows archive's exact hash, version, valid Verify/Run, JSON v1 error coordinates, and Studio's native process service. New alpha.15 ELF64 and compiler-cache changes are Rust embedding / experimental kernel features, **not** new Scarp Studio UI functions. Alpha.15's string-comparison work accounting can reject programs that previously fit narrow work budgets.

## Limitations

- Windows 11 x64 first. No Linux/macOS desktop installers in this candidate.
- No semantic Go-to-Definition, verified language server, debugger, generalized terminal or unrestricted recursive workspace search.
- The release remains unsigned and experimental; Windows security warnings must be evaluated, never bypassed on assumption of safety.
- A successful GitHub Actions run **does not** prove Windows GUI behavior or that every filesystem-permission scenario works. Manual checks remain mandatory.
- Native file consistency checks are best-effort, not OS-level atomic snapshots. File symlinks/junctions and external edits still require careful review.
- This candidate is source code and CI artifacts until independently approved; the previously published `v0.0.1-alpha.2` remains editor-only.

## Reviewer checklist before owner approval

- [ ] Review consolidated integration PR #55, stacked PRs #56–#58 and the release-preparation PR that contains this file. Do not merge ancestor branches separately as duplicated changes.
- [ ] Confirm the **exact candidate commit** has green frontend, native Rust, official Scarp alpha.10–alpha.15 smoke, Windows executable, unsigned NSIS and checksum/tamper checks.
- [ ] Run `npm run check:release-candidate` and `npm run test:release-candidate`. All six manifest versions must match `0.0.2-alpha.1`; these commands do not publish.
- [ ] Download executable, installer and checksum artifacts from **one single green workflow run** and verify them in a clean directory with `scripts/verify-windows-artifacts.ps1` against that run's exact commit.
- [ ] Record actual Windows 11 GUI results for the scenarios in `docs/windows-11-acceptance.md`, including P28–P30 and C12.
- [ ] Fix all blocking failures, repeat CI and manual tests after any candidate changes.
- [ ] Obtain distinct, explicit owner approval for merging to `main` and subsequently publishing the **exact approved source commit** as `v0.0.2-alpha.1`.

**No tag, release, installer publication, signing claim or successful Windows GUI acceptance is implied.**
